newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - August 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - August 1.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Stock index soars past 10,000 points, central bank tightens monetary policy.
Saint Lucia accepts US$1 million donation from China, refuses to attend Taiwan-organised "Caribbean region foreign ministers' conference".
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Central bank raises rediscount rate, secured loan rate to stabilise foreign exchange market.
Taiwan to launch fresh islandwide crackdown on organised crime.
LIBERTY TIMES - Share prices rise past 10,000 points, Taiwan dollar drops to new low.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Central bank slightly tightens monetary policy to try to stabilise exchange rate.
Six large conglomerates, led by food giant President Enterprise, to invest in Association of Southeast Asian Nations
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Central bank raises rediscount rate and secured loan rate, central banker says move not targetting stock market but aims to stablise forex market
Taiwan dollar drops to lowest level since October 27, 1988, at T$28.7; stock index rises above 10,000 points to seven-year high.
